Commentary.Commentary: England need to bat really well here as the wicket has started to misbehave a bit. The odd one staying low, some extra bounce and some turn too. The Indian bowlers will back themselves on this wicket so stay tuned for England's reply with the bat to see how things unfold.

Earlier, it was Virat Kohli and Cheteshwar Pujara's 226-run stand which put India on the top. The Indian skipper got out after a terrific 167 and Pujara smashed another ton. For England, Anderson was the pick of the bowlers yesterday as he picked three wickets but today he didn't bowl that much. Moeen Ali got three wickets in the first session today while Rashid got two in this one. So India will be happy with their total overall.

England have wasted no time to dismiss the Indian tail in this session. Ashwin got out after his well-composed fifty. Stokes got his rewards when he took Ashwin's wicket and towards the end Umesh Yadav provided some entertainment with the bat and the last pair helped India cross the 450-run mark.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar is happy that he had rightly predicted the ball turning from the first day itself. He though adds that he was surprised by it not being a rank turner. Opines that this one has no grass and hence the pitch is more vulnerable to crumble in comparison to the one in Rajkot. Reckons the ball will keep low more often, there will be more turn on offer. Nasser Hussain concludes that this is a first innings wicket, since the first few days will be the best time to bat.

England on the other hand, will be relatively pleased with their effort. They came into the game high on confidence but their execution yesterday was far from ideal. They dropped Kohli on 56 and it could very well be a match defining moment. Anderson has picked up three on a wicket which has assisted the spinners and that should disappoint England. They will hope to restrict India as much possible since batting is only going to get tougher from here on.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the second Test between India and England at Dr. Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium, Visakhapatnam. Having won the toss, India made the most of the good batting conditions to notch up a good score on board. Virat Kohli has led the charge for the hosts with an unbeaten 151 and will be itching to ensure they post a massive total. He got able support from Cheteshwar Pujara as they shared a 226-run stand. India lost both Pujara and Rahane in the final session and they will hope that the lower order can hang around with the skipper.
DAY 2...SESSION 1....

England will hope to return fresh tomorrow morning and comeback in the game with a flurry of wickets as the deck will start to crumble sooner than later. India will want to ensure they bat big and with the skipper out there for them, expect no let up from the hosts. Do join us for all the action from Day 2 tomorrow at 0930 IST. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

The English bowlers were made to toil hard for wickets. The spinners did get assistance from the wicket but they were not consistent enough and the pressure was never on India to score against the run of play. Ali, Rashid and Ansari, all of them were far too short, too often. Anderson was the best bowler for England, taking three of the four wickets to fall today.

Once again it is the captain who has led from the front for India with a fine, fine unbeaten knock of 151. He got good support from Cheteshwar Pujara who also registered a ton to save India from 22 for 2. They shared a 226-run stand and despite the hiccups in the running, they were always in control of the game. Pujara fell soon after getting to his ton and Rahane fell just at the stroke of stumps but India will be the happier of the two teams.

Excellent length ball outside off, swinging away from Ajinkya Rahane, he raises his bat skyward and lets the ball go past him.
The second new ball has been taken. And it will be Anderson to take it. Guess I was wrong about him.
Shorter in length and on a flatter trajectory, outside off, tapped onto the track below off the back foot.
Floated around off, it's pushed to sweeper cover for one run.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out from within the crease.
Extremely full on middle and off, Kohli spanks this down to long on really hard. A single taken.
Rahane looks to turn it on the leg side but it goes off his pads. A leg bye is taken.
Short and wide outside off, on a flatter trajectory, it's hit through to deep cover for a single.
Anderson is off the field. Seems he is done for the day.
Sprays this on the pads once more, a hint of swing on that occasion, it's worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Keeps it on the fuller side and fires it on the pads, comfortably flicked through square leg for one run.
Fullish well outside off, easy enough for Jinx to plant his front foot across and push it in front of covers.
Fuller length ball pitched just outside off, Ajinkya Rahane leans forward and buries it into the track ahead.
On a good length and attacking the stumps, stays back and blocks.
Good length delivery shaping in on middle and off, a slower one, really slow, at 80 kph, it's flicked through square leg for a single.
JAMES ANDERSON is back on to bowl now.
Turning away from outside off, Ajinkya Rahane plays this towards point for no run.
Full ball darted in on off, driven to mid off.

Great effort from Captain Cook! Back of a length on a flatter trajectory, Rahane gets back and firmly pulls it past a diving Ben Duckett at short mid-wicket. Cook from mid on chases after the ball and puts in a wonderful dive to keep it just inside the ropes. The batsmen take two runs.
Attacks the stumps with this full ball, kept out well by the batsman.
Rashid brings out the googly but it's picked up well by Rahane. He stays deep in his crease and off the back foot, tickles it fine down the leg side for two good runs.
Flatter and shorter, sliding in on middle and off, Kohli camps back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Floats it up around off, Rahane takes a big stride forward and meets the ball with a solid, straight bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat outside off, Virat Kohli hangs back and punches it through to sweeper cover for a run.

That was close. It's full on middle and off, Kohli closes the face a little too early as he attempts to flick it away. The ball goes off the leading edge and falls just short of silly mid off and the bowler. Was in the air for a good while.
Slider on middle and leg, Kohli works this through the square leg region for  a couple.
From around the wicket, Zafar Ansari tosses it up on middle and off, Kohli with a forward press blocks it out.
Another short one outside off, Jinx rocks onto his back foot and crunches it through the covers. The fielder gives it a chase and pulls the ball just inside the ropes. Keeps the batsmen down to two.
Drags the length back on this and pitches it on off, Rahane offers a back foot punch.
That kept real low. Good job by Rahane to bring his bat down in time. The slowness of the pitch aided Ajinkya in doing so as he worked it to the leg side.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's driven to wide long off. Kohli eased that away by opening his body up a bit.
Flights it around off, it's turning away sharply, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Flatter and shorter, turning from on middle and off, Kohli goes back and whips it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Takes a big stride forward and blocks it off the front foot.
Full, very full on the stumps, Ansari provides a lot of flight on this, Virat brings the wrists into play and drills it down to long on for a single.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot.
Loopy and full on off, it's driven wristily towards mid off.
Tossed up once more, again Ansari gives it a lot of air, Kohli comes ahead and pushes it a bit square on the off side.
Ansari gives this plenty of air and tosses it up around off, Virat Kohli prods forward and makes sure he pushes it back out with a straight blade.
Works this fullish delivery to the mid-wicket region.
A bit of turn but not much, really. Easy enough for the batsman to defend it.
Ajinkya Rahane presses forward and does well to keep it out off the front foot.
Turning away from around off, Rahane has nothing to do with that one.
Loopy and on a fuller length, pitched on off, Kohli eases it down to long off for a single.
Floated ball around off, VK plays this off the front foot and into the track.
Around off, it's blocked on the off side to end the over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy and fullish in length, it's driven down towards mid off.
Places himself behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out.
Floated ball around off, Kohli plays with the turn and pushes it to covers.
Short and wide outside off, Rahane cuts it away to deep point for a single.
The second new ball is due now and the reviews are refreshed as well. Not sure if England will take the new ball rightaway with the light not quite being at its best.

NOT OUT! Kohli survives. But it was really close. Moeen Ali tosses up a loopy off breaker around off, it's on a fullish length and it's turning in sharply. Kohli kneels down to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the front pad. England appeal for an lbw but it's given as not out. Bairstow is confident and so, asks his captain to take the review. In any case the reviews will be refreshed so they might as well. It goes upstairs and replays show the ball to be clipping leg stump. It turned a really long way. The visitors are quite unfortunate really.
A lbw decision against Virat Kohli is reviewed.
A lot of air on that occasion, outside off, it's driven hard straight to short cover.

That was borderline dangerous. Played it really, really late. On a length, turning in from around off, Virat Kohli backs away and with an open face, runs it past the vacant slip cordon. Picks up two runs for it.
A bit flatter on middle, Rahane skips down the track and ends up playing it off the inside half of the bat past short leg. Picks up a run for it.
Loopy and fullish in length, worked in front of short leg off the front foot.
Lovely tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Kohli clears his front leg and flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for one run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length and it's punched off the back foot by Ajinkya Rahane.
Rahane offers a solid front foot defensive shot and keeps this one out.
Looped up and attacking the stumps, Virat Kohli takes a step ahead and eases it back down to long off for a single.
Another shorter one, on a flatter trajectory once more, punched off the back foot to the leg side.
Flatter ball sliding in on the stumps, kept out off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
ZAFAR ANSARI back on for a bowl.
Kohli goes back, works it off his pads and tucks it down towards fine leg for a single to end the over.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Off breaker turning in on middle, Ajinkya turns it through square leg for one run.
Gets to the pitch of the delivery and plays it right back to the bowler.
On a flatter trajectory and turning in from outside off, Rahane goes back and works in on the on side.
Floats it up around off, Rahane comes forward to defend.
It's going way down leg, VK looks to go after it but misses.
Stands tall in his crease and blocks.
FOUR! Shot. Short and wide outside off, Kohli hangs back and slaps it through the off side for a boundary. Pierced the gap well and sent it all the way.
Touch fuller around off, it's kept out off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery just around off, tight line from Ben, Virat Kohli stays back and taps it down on the off side.
Angles in a length ball ball from around off, Kohli stays behind the line and blocks.
On the pads, played towards backward square again for a single.
Floated outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Turns in, worked to square leg off the crease.
Rahane pushes one to mid on and calls Kohli through for a quick single. Rashid at mid on is a bit slow and that allows the completion of the single.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter outside off, Rahane goes back and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter on the pads, Kohli tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Full and angling in on middle, Rahane comes forward and keeps it out.
FOUR! Nicely done! Good length outside off, guided down to the third man fence for a boundary. That was a superb shot and Rahane was always in control of that one.
Good length on off, Rahane covers the line and pushes it towards covers.
Full outside off, Kohli pushes it on the up through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball! Bowls it on the pads, going down, Kohli clips it through backward square leg for a boundary.
On a length outside off, Kohli pushes it towards covers.
Fuller on off, Rahane comes forward and keeps it out.
Shorter on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Pushes this one towards covers for a quick single.
On the pads, Kohli tucks it towards the on side off his crease.
Slips it down the leg side, Kohli misses his clip.
MOEEN ALI to bowl now.
Drinks!
Fuller on off, kept out by Rahane.

Good length on middle and leg, Rahane looks to clip it through but is rapped on the pads. Stokes appeals but the umpire says no. Stokes wants to review but Cook tells him it is going down leg and a bit high too.
This time it is on the stumps, Rahane covers the line and defends it.
Sprays this one down the leg side, Rahane cannot clip it.
Rahane comes forward and lets it go through.
Good length on middle, Rahane clips it towards mid-wicket.
STOKES returns for a bowl.
Fuller on the stumps, Kohli keeps it out.
Slams this one back down the wicket but to the bowler.
Kohli comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Sliced! Floated outside off, Kohli slices it through the backward point region for a boundary. That was nicely done.
Fuller outside off, Rahane drives it off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Rahane stays back and defends it.
Kohli pushes it towards mid on off his crease.
Full length outside off, Kohli plays at it from his crease and is beaten all ends up. Good period of play for England.
Kohli clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shorter length outside off, keeps low, Kohli tucks it towards square leg off the inside edge.
Fuller on the pads, Kohli clips it sweetly through square leg. Rashid gets across to his right, looks to stop the ball but fumbles a touch. Does well to keep the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Fuller on off, Kohli comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Turn and bounce! Bowled outside leg, that turns a long way, Rahane cannot put to bat to ball.
And again Rahane goes back to this one and mistimes it towards mid on off the edge onto his pads.
Rahane comes forward and defends it.
He has been out playing the cut shot. This one again is on off, shorter length, Rahane cuts it off the bottom edge. That was not needed.
Kohli punches it towards long on for a single.
Stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
Outside off, Rahane pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Kohli clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Kohli punches it towards covers off his crease.
Fuller on middle, Rahane clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length, guided down to third man for a run.
Fuller outside off, Kohli drives it towards covers off his crease.
This one spins a touch, Rahane reads it well and plays it towards point.
Fuller on off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Punches it to covers for a single.
Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Kohli hits it hard through covers for a couple of runs. That brings up the 250 for India!
Fuller on middle, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it outside off, this one bounces a lot more and Rahane is taken back. Thankfully for him, he did not poke at it.
Fuller on off, Rahane covers the line and despite the low bounce, keeps it out.
AJINKYA RAHANE is the new man in.

OUT! Poor shot! Sprays it wide outside off, Pujara again goes for the slash through third man. He only manages to edge it through to the keeper for a catch to his right. Anderson is all pumped up and why not. A wicket at last and a mammoth 226-run stand comes to an end. Pujara won't be happy though, he normally converts this tons into big ones but has not done so for the second time in a row.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Fuller outside off, Pujara slams it hard and through mid off for a boundary. That was superbly timed and hit wide of the fielder.
Fuller on off, Pujara keeps it out back to the bowler.
Bowls it on off, Pujara defends it towards short mid-wicket off the inner half.
Fuller on middle, Kohli presses forward and defends it.
Tucks it wide of square leg for a single.
Kohli pushes it to long off for a single.

Tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. There is an overthrow at the striker's end and Pujara gets five extra runs. Ben Stokes was the one who was backing up but could not stop the throw from Ansari.
Floated on leg, Pujara comes forward and defends it with his bat and pad together.
Kohli comes forward and defends it towards mid off for a single.
Pujara comes forward and defends it off the inner half towards the on side.
Pushes this one towards third man for a single.
Good length outside off, Kohli taps it towards covers off his back foot.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Kohli mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Outside off, Kohli defends it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Short outside off, cut towards point for a single.
Kohli pushes it back down the wicket.
Pujara comes forward and defends it to the cover-point and takes a quick single. Bairstow appeals for some reason.
Shorter outside off, this one goes through well, Pujara defends it towards covers.
Bowls it outside leg, keeps low as it spins a touch, Pujara does well to keep it out.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Gets this off the outer half towards third man for a single.
A touch short outside off, Kohli punches it nicely but not in the gap.
Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Is confident and drives it towards covers off his crease.
Bowls it down the leg side, Kohli cannot clip it through.
14th Test century for Virat Kohli!

Well played, Virat Kohli! Length ball outside off from Anderson, Kohli pushes it through covers for a couple to bring up his century. How apt it comes off the bowling of Anderson. The man had troubled him so much, he had his fair share today but has fought hard and played well. He raises his bat to acknowledge the applause and support.
James Anderson returns for a bowl.
Pujara stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
Presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Pujara digs out this fuller one back to the bowler.
This time he gets a single with a drive to covers.
Kohli comes forward and pushes it to covers.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Kohli places it towards gully and looks for a single but is sent back in time and rightly so.
Fuller outside off, Kohli pushes it to covers and looks for a single. Broad was interested to take a review. Not sure why though.
Shorter length on middle, pulled through square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot by Pujara.
Pujara gets in line and keeps it out.
On a length on off, Pujara keeps it out.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers. They look for a single at first but then decide against it.
Shorter on the pads, Kohli clips it to backward square leg off his crease.
Goes back and punches it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Tucks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The crowd is excited as Kohli is on strike, on 98.
10th Test century for Cheteshwar Pujara!

SIX! What a way to get to your Test ton! No nerves or anything, he gets a gift from Rashid, it is short on middle, Pujara camps back and pulls it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a maximum. 200-RUN STAND COMES UP AS WELL.
Floated on middle, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Fuller on middle, Kohli clips it towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Gloved! Shorter length ball on off and middle, Kohli is a touch cramped for room but does well to pull it wide of the keeper for a boundary. Moves on to 98!
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, Kohli places it towards gully off his crease.
Shorter outside off, swings in late after Kohli lets it go.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, pushed to deep covers for a single. Kohli hit that in the air and he is not happy with himself.
Flatter on the pads, turned through backward square leg for a single. Pujara was sprinting for the second but Kohli was just not aware.
Outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it nicely.
Floated outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, cut through covers for a single.

OUCH! Shorter on off, keeps a touch low, pulls it hard towards short mid-wicket where Zafar Ansari fumbles. He is hit on right on the box. He looks to be in some pain. He just let the ball through and is down. Rashid is all smiles though. The physio attends and Ansari seems fine now.
ADIL RASHID to bowl from the other end.
Fuller and angling on the pads, Kohli clips it through square leg for a single. That kept a tad low. Moves to 92!
On a length on middle, Kohli clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Pujara drives it through mid off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
The players are back out in the middle for the final session of play. VIRAT KOHLI and CHETESHWAR PUJARA are out to bat. STUART BROAD to finish the over...
DAY 1... SESSION 3...

England tried a lot of things but were not disciplined enough. Virat and Pujara both milked the spinners at will, finding the gaps as and whenever they pleased. None of the bowlers were threatening enough and dropping Kohli did not help them either. They will hope to strike soon since they will know India might run away with the Test with a massive first innings score. Join us in a while for the final session.

That's how dominating India have been, a local dog has ensured a break here. It was in fact the first ball after lunch, how the entire session went for England. It was a nicely clipped boundary for Kohli and the runs just kept flowing for India right throughout. They racked up 118 runs in the session without losing a wicket and have run England ragged in the field. Both of them have had their style of play. Kohli has driven well through the off side while Pujara has used his feet superbly to score at a good rate. Both of them are nearing their respective tons and will want to ensure they not just get there but bat on and score big.

There's a dog on the field and Stuart Broad shoos him away. The ground staff rush behind him but the dog keeps on running and off the field. Oh dear, he's back on the field again and he is looking simply unstoppable. The kids are enjoying this completely. The umpires decide to take the TEA BREAK!
Yet another left alone outside off.
Wide outside off, Pujara allows it through.
Shortish on the pads, Pujara whips it through mid-wicket for a single.

The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Landed around off, Kohli covers the line and defends.
Tossed up outside off, Kohli blocks it out into the ground.
Wide outside off, CP doesn't flirt with it.
Good length outside off, Pujara leaves it alone.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Pujara reaches out and cuts it past backward point for a boundary. Pujara moves to 96 now. It's an 8-1 off side field but still he's getting boundaries.
In the corridor outside off, Pujara allows it through.
Wide outside off, Pujara shoulders his arms.
Landed outside off, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Full on off, Pujara drives it to mid off.
Landed just outside off, defended watchfully by Pujara.
FOUR! Boundaries simply continue to flow! Pujara comes forward and takes it on the full to drive it through coves for a four.

Fullish on middle and leg, Pujara pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish outside off, stays a tad low, Pujara tries to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Adil Rashid back on.
Outside off, steered away to third man for a single.
Landed outside off, Pujara punches it to the off side.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Pujara drives it past the mid off region and gets another boundary.
Landed outside off, Pujara gets onto his front foot and defends.
Way outside off, Pujara leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli leans onto it and drives it through covers for a single.
Stuart Broad comes back on as England looking for a desperate breakthrough.
Outside off, Pujara comes down the track and blocks. India have scored 39 runs in the last five overs.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Pujara takes a step forward and drives it past mid on for another boundary. Excellent run rate for India in this session.
Shortish on off, Pujara punches it away off his back foot.
Now Kohli works it away through the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Two in two! This is good batting! Outside off, VK steers it to the third man region and gets back-to-back boundaries. Runs are coming thick and fast for India.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Full outside off, Kohli drives it firmly through the cover region for a glorious boundary.
Full outside off, Kohli drills it through mid off. Almost went off the outer half of the bat there. Single taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed around off, VK blocks it out into the ground.
Worked away through backward square leg by Kohli this time for another couple.
Shortish again outside off, Kohli cuts it off his back foot through point and comes back for the second. Root throws it quickly back towards the stumps but still looks a bit frustrated.
Shortish outside off, Pujara punches it through covers and takes an easy single.
Fullish outside off, driven towards mid on by the Indian skipper.
Flighted ball outside off, Kohli covers the line and defends.
Tossed up ball outside off, VK defends it into the ground.
Flatter ball on off, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
150-run stand up between Kohli and Pujara!
FOUR! Lucky Kohli! Full on middle, turning in and staying very low, Kohli tries to flick but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat, almost an under edge and through fine leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, Kohli drives it to covers but finds the fielder.
FOUR! Pujara steps forward this time and takes it on the full, smacks it hard through mid off and gets a boundary now to end the over. Good over for India!
SIX! Poor ball, punished! Half tracker on off, Pujara goes onto his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball lands in the stands where the kids are cheering out loudly.
Fullish on off, Kohli rocks back and works it through backward square leg for a single.
Pujara drills it to long on and takes a single this time.
Landed around off, Pujara comes forward to play this one.
On middle, Kohli goes deep in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Zafar Ansari back on.

Played through point by Pujara for a single.

Full on off, driven to long on for a single.

Flighted ball outside off, turning in, Kohli tries to flick off his back foot but the ball brushes off the pads and goes to the keeper behind. Bairstow appeals but the umpire says not out straightaway.
There was some issue with the ball between the overs. Looks like the umpire changed the ball too.
Down the leg side, Pujara leaves it alone.

Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Pujara pulls it towards long leg. Anderson runs to his left from fine leg and puts in a dive to stop the ball. His feet is stuck in the ground too. Good effort in the end but he'll have to be careful. Some outfields are dangerous. Remember Simon Jones at the 'Gabba? His feet were stuck in that outfield and he got injured.
Comes round the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, Pujara pushes it towards point.

Drinks!
FOUR! Stokes it ticking! Bowls it on the pads, Kohli gets across and tucks it towards fine leg where Rashid again fails to keep the ball in and concedes a boundary.
WIDE! Bangs it short but way down the leg side, Kohli is more than happy to leave it.
Shorter on off, Kohli looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto his body. He was looking to keep it down.
Opens the face of the bat and takes a single to third man.
Pujara rides this short one and tucks it towards the leg side.

Dropped! Back of a length outside off, comes in, Kohli goes for the pull but does not keep it down. The ball travels off the top edge to deep fine leg. Adil Rashid stationed there fails to get under it and drops it. Cook, Stokes, Root none are impressed. How costly will it be? Kohli almost fell into the trap there.
Back of a length on middle, Kohli tucks it towards the on side.
Turns and bounce from a length outside off, Kohli tucks it off the pads with the turn towards backward square leg for a single. That came off the thigh pad and hence a leg bye is signaled.

Stays in his crease and defends it.

NOT OUT! PUJARA SURVIVES, ENGLAND REVIEW IN VAIN! Floated outside off, Pujara looks to defend but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. Bairstow and Ali are confident and go for the review. Impact was the only thing that could have been reason for it being not out. Replays show the impact was outside off and hitting the stumps so the on-field call stays.  Moeen Ali asks about the decision.
Appeal for an LBW turned down. England take a review...
This time it dishes it outside off, Pujara cracks it through point. Duckett gives it a chase and keeps them to three.
Shorter length again but it is way down the leg side. Pujara is not going to go after them. England are wasting these here.
Back of a length outside off, punched towards covers.
Sprays it down the leg side, on a shorter length, easy leave for Pujara.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot.
Shorter length on middle and leg, but going down leg. Pujara can leave it alone easily.

Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.

Keeps it short outside off, placed behind point for a single.

MOEEN ALI is the new bowler.
11th Test fifty for Cheteshwar Pujara!

FOUR! Fine shot! Fuller outside off, Pujara leans into it and drives it to the left of the mid off fielder for a boundary. That brings up another fifty for him. His good run of form continues. Also brings up the 100-RUN STAND!
Takes a single with a guide behind point.

England captain Alastair Cook says it's a good toss to win but now they have nothing to lose and the pressure is on India now. Adds Rajkot was a result pitch but there will be turn at this venue. Mentions as per rotation policy, Chris Woakes misses out and James Anderson is making his comeback.

Indian captain, Virat Kohli says there will be turn later on here, maybe from the second day itself. Feels it's a typical Vizag wicket with even covering of grass and it might be challenging for the batsmen. Mentions they have two changes, Jayant Yadav is making his Test debut, replacing Amit Mishra while KL Rahul replaces Gautam Gambhir.

TOSS - INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND WILL BAT! That's a vital toss won. The off-spinner Jayant Yadav to make his Test debut. Interestingly, he made his ODI debut at this very ground against New Zealand. Team changes coming up.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar reckons it is a turner and the ball will turn from Day 1. There is no grass, it is very dry but the pitch has the history of turning a lot as the game progresses. Nasser Hussain adds that it is not that hard and it may break up earlier than usual.

Both Virat Kohli and Joe Root are playing their 50th Test and which one of the two fares better will have an impact on the result. All eyes will be on the pitch after the first Test was played on a relatively placid deck. This is the first Test in Visakhapatnam and it should be interesting to see if it's a turner as expected. Let's see what combinations both teams go in with. India could hand out a debut to either of Hardik Pandya or Karun Nair in place of a misfiring Amit Mishra. Do not leave out a chance for a surprise debut to Jayant Yadav with the number of left-handed batsmen in England.
